sportsbook_snapshot.quote_limitations: CSV snapshot only; not independently verified live; over-side quotes only; main line proxied by available over price closest to -110

methodology.historical_cutoff: Completion of final scheduled Week 9 game
methodology.p15: 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games; standard linear interpolation; unavailable if fewer than 20
methodology.qualification: Market HR >=60% OR at least one fixed ladder threshold >=80%; L10 denominator
methodology.current_market: DraftKings; choose available line with over odds closest to -110 as a main-line proxy; record one-sided price as snapshot, not independently verified live
methodology.market_hr: For each market, count L10 game results strictly greater than the selected half-point line; no pushes possible

notes: User explicitly authorized DraftKings throughout the analysis.
DraftKings matchup odds CSV has 440 rows for WAS Commanders @ NY Giants.
The file provides over-side odds only; no under prices are populated.
Main-market line is proxied by the available over-price closest to -110. It is not independently confirmed as the book's canonical main line.
Odds are from the GitHub CSV snapshot, not independently verified live quotes.
Cam Skattebo has no matching DraftKings player rows in the retrieved matchup snapshot; his historical ladder data remains, but current market and market HR are unavailable.
All eligible players identified in the matchup odds feed are included, including Van Jefferson and Theo Johnson, which were omitted from the first Stage 1 export.
Players with fewer than 10 historical games have unavailable L10 and cannot qualify through Market HR; ladder qualification remains unavailable.
